---
title: "Analyze NHANES data sets"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cli)

nhanes_dermatology <- read_csv("data/nhanes_dermatology.csv") |>
  mutate(across(c(sun_reaction, shade, long_sleeves, sunscreen), as.factor))

nhanes_sleep <- read_csv("data/nhanes_sleep.csv") |>
  mutate(across(c(snore, stop_breathing, overly_sleepy), as.factor))
```

## Plot one variable

```{r}
#| label: nhanes-plot-var
nhanes_plot_var <- function(data, var, n = 5) {
  data <-
    data |>
    filter(!is.na({{ var }}), {{ var }} != "Don't know")

  data |>
    mutate({{ var }} := fct_lump({{ var }}, n = n)) |>
    ggplot(aes({{ var }})) +
    geom_bar()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: nhanes-plot-var-run
nhanes_plot_var(nhanes_dermatology, shade)
```
